name: sci-repl
description: Mobile Scientific REPL — Python + Pyodide + Plotly.js

scripts.sync: npm run configure && npm run fetch:bundles && npx cap sync
scripts.build:debug: npm run configure && npm run fetch:bundles && npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release:aab: npm run configure && npm run fetch:bundles && npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:release:apk: npm run configure && npm run fetch:bundles && npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
